name: Namespace (conch)
description: A Namespace sandbox for each workspace, with its branch cloned, made by conch-sandbox. Needs a Namespace API key: NSC_TOKEN, or conch-sandbox key set namespace.
create: printf %s '' | base64 -d | sh -s -- create --provider namespace --from-orca --format orca
resume: printf %s '' | base64 -d | sh -s -- start --provider namespace --from-orca --format orca
